The in-store service was good, I won't argue with that. But the service after braces removal was terrible.
-First issue: I was very patient the first time I had my braces removed on October 28th. I requested home delivery and paid 100 baht for shipping. They called to inform me that it had been shipped on November 1st. I waited and asked for the tracking number, but they didn't reply. So I didn't follow up or rush them. Then on November 6th, my teeth started separating, so I messaged them again, but they couldn't reply and just said it had been shipped. Then on November 8th, the package arrived, and the box said it was shipped on the 7th. I knew they were lying. I paid for the shipping myself, it wasn't free. I stayed silent and asked if there would be any compensation, but they said no.
-I tried to order a retainer since December 25th. It took a long time to reply, and even then, the replies were incomplete. They said I could order online and they had the file, but they didn't send a sample. They said the price was 3200 baht + 100 baht shipping. I was confused, so I screenshotted the promotion they sent, which said 999 baht and ended on the 31st. When I asked what that promotion was, they couldn't answer and said they would call me back. Just wait a little longer, it's the 29th already.
***If you don't want to provide service like this, just close down. I'm not begging, I'm paying for this too. Terrible service. The first time was quiet, but this is the second time. I want you to read this so you can improve. If you don't have enough staff, hire more. In short, it's absolutely awful.

Since getting braces, I feel like this clinic doesn't care about its orthodontists at all. I'm seeing a doctor who's quite well-known, but they don't update the treatment plan, changing the elastics takes less than 5 minutes, and they don't even check the patient's teeth. It's like they just want to get it over with. I understand there are many patients waiting, but as a dentist, shouldn't they check more thoroughly than just changing the elastics? It's a huge waste of time. I've been getting treatment here for almost two years, and it's a waste of time. Maybe it's because I didn't get veneers that I didn't receive the same good service.

I'm writing this review based on my personal experience after undergoing orthodontic treatment at this clinic for approximately two years.

My reason for starting orthodontic treatment was to have beautifully aligned teeth and gain more confidence in my smile. However, after a long period of treatment, I felt that the results did not meet my expectations, and I didn't see as much change in my teeth as I had hoped.

Throughout the treatment, I felt that I received very little information about the treatment plan. I wasn't kept in touch with the progress of my teeth's movement or how long it would take to complete, which caused me anxiety and a lack of confidence on several occasions.

Ultimately, I decided to request the removal of the braces before the end of the treatment plan because I no longer wished to continue treatment. What I regret most is the lack of communication on the day I requested the removal. I felt that I didn't receive the advice or understanding from the patient's perspective that I had expected.

This review is solely based on my personal experience, aiming to provide those who are considering orthodontic treatment with another perspective to help them make an informed decision.
